bai: Bai 24 - Record Macro (ghi macro tu dong)

cong_thuc.cu_phap_chuan: Right-click Ribbon > Customize the Ribbon > tick Developer

cong_thuc.cu_phap_chuan: Developer > Record Macro: ten viet lien khong dau; Shortcut key bo trong; Store in: This Workbook
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bat dau ghi: moi click/go duoc dich sang VBA. Dat ten viet lien (Thang1), tranh trung Ctrl+C.

cong_thuc.vi_du_chay_duoc: Alt+F11 > Module1 > Sub GhiMacro() ... End Sub > F5

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bien dong thanh chu thich (mau xanh); dung vo hieu dong thua nhu Range("D9").Select.
Selection = vung dang chon (tong quat); Range co dinh chi chay dung o cu. Muon ap moi o phai xoa dong co dinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du_chay_duoc: Xoa Range("D9").Select, giu Selection.Font.Bold=True > chay o bat ky
cong_thuc.loi_thuong_gap: Giu Range co dinh chay nham o

cong_thuc.cu_phap_chuan: Developer > Insert > Button > ve nut > Assign Macro

cong_thuc.cu_phap_chuan: Insert > Shapes > ve hinh > Right-click > Assign Macro

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lenh record duoc khi click qua sheet; dung lam muc luc nhay sheet.

cong_thuc.vi_du_chay_duoc: BAT Relative > mui ten xuong 1 o > Paste > TAT Relative

cong_thuc.loi_thuong_gap: Table co dong trong loc thieu

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Giu lai macro/Button. Luu .xlsx se MAT macro khi mo lai.

cong_thuc.ten: Hoc lenh qua VBE — Alt+F11 + Ctrl+G

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Xoa dinh dang vung test truoc khi bam nut de thay ro ket qua macro.
cong_thuc.vi_du_chay_duoc: Boi den vung test > Clear Formats > bam nut

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.thao_tac: Buoc 1 (Bat Developer + chuan bi sheet): Right-click Ribbon > Customize > tick Developer > Chuan bi Main (muc luc), Du lieu 1/2/3, Input, Data, Tim kiem
Buoc 2 (Muc luc nhay sheet): Ve Shape 'Du lieu thang 1' > Record Thang1 (This Workbook) > click Du lieu 1 > Stop > Assign macro vao shape > Lap Thang2/Thang3 tuong tu
Buoc 3 (Nut quay lai + copy nut): Record QuayLaiMain (click ve Main) > tao nut tren moi sheet du lieu > gan macro > Copy/Paste hoac Ctrl+keo nut (giu macro)
thuat_toan_quy_trinh.luu_y: Kiem tra vung sau paste/fill; Ctrl+Z ngay neu sai

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.thao_tac: Buoc 4 (Nhap lieu tu dong (Relative+Transpose)): Tao nut 'Cap nhat' > Record: copy Input > sang Data > B3 > Ctrl+Mui ten xuong > BAT Relative > xuong 1 o > Paste Special Transpose > TAT Relative > ve Input xoa trang > Stop > gan nut > Test NV moi (vd so 4) sang Data kiem tra
thuat_toan_quy_trinh.luu_y: Kiem tra vung sau paste/fill; Ctrl+Z ngay neu sai

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.thao_tac: Buoc 5 (Tim kiem Advanced Filter + .xlsm): Ctrl+T chuan hoa vung > record Advanced Filter (Ho Nguyen, Nu...) > gan nut Tim kiem/Tim moi > Alt+F11 xoa dong Range thua, them ' ghi chu; test 2-3 lan; luu .xlsm
